findings.title: Broken receipt/evidence capture for the orchestrator-replay producer (G5)
findings.detail: logs/orchestrator-replay-20260914T074439Z.log and its baseline sibling are 0 bytes; receipts.jsonl records logBytes:0, pass:null, fail:null for both, yet G5 states 'Producer: 80 pass 0 fail' citing that empty file as evidence. Root cause: factory-orchestrator-coverage.sh writes its spec reporter to $COV_OUT/test-progress.log, not stdout, so the receipt wrapper captured nothing. Independently reproduced 80 pass / 0 fail by rerunning the producer directly, so the underlying claim is true, but the evidence chain does not currently substantiate it.
findings.functional_impact: none observed; independently reproduced the claimed result
